---
name: Feature Suggestion
about: Suggest a product or public-repository improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## Summary

What would you like Campaign Manager to improve or add?

## Problem / use case

What campaign, deployment or documentation problem would this solve?

## Suggested behaviour

Describe the outcome rather than private implementation details.

## Scope

- [ ] Public documentation / repository
- [ ] Installation / deployment experience
- [ ] Campaign workflow
- [ ] Geography
- [ ] Field / agent operations
- [ ] Election monitoring / reporting
- [ ] Communications
- [ ] Other

## Why it matters

Who would benefit and how?

## Sensitive-data reminder

Do not include campaign records, supporter/member information, credentials, tokens, `.env`, QuickStart keys or private political information.

> Note: the private Campaign Manager core source is not maintained publicly in this repository. A public feature suggestion can still be considered without exposing private source code.
